title: Evidence ingestion and gate automation playbook for compliance milestones
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Goal: define and implement a repeatable evidence ingestion and gate automation playbook that reduces manual toil for SOC2/ISO checkpoints (SSO/SAML configuration, audit log retention, access control evidence). The playbook should map evidence sources, owners, expected formats, automated collection where possible, and fail-open/rollback procedures for gating releases. Deliverables: canonical evidence catalog, ingestion automation prototypes, per-milestone runbook, and dashboard-linked health signals.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical evidence catalog published with owners and retention rules
Two automated collectors (SSO config snapshot, auditlog export snapshot) running on schedule with SLA <= 24h
Runbook includes gating steps for canary/cutover and rollback checklist
Dashboard shows evidence freshness and flags missing items with assignee and SLA burn-down
comments: 2026-02-20: Created ticket and initial scope after cross-functional sync with Security and Infra. Agreed to focus MVP on SSO config snapshots and audit log exports.
2026-02-25: PM/Eng trade-off: full end-to-end automation vs. phased approach. Decided phased: prioritize reliable collection and verification, defer full automated attestation to next cycle.

2026-03-02: Design review notes from Aisha Patel: prefer simple CSV/JSON artifact schema with schema versioning; add 'schema_version' and 'collected_by' metadata fields to all artifacts. Action: ENG to add small header wrapper to exports.

2026-03-05: ENG-3678 spike completed: prototype SSO snapshot tool that exports SAML metadata and IdP settings. Found edge case for multiple IdP endpoints in legacy customers; added normalization step.

2026-03-08: Security review kickoff scheduled. Shared draft runbook in Confluence. Security requested encryption-at-rest for evidence artifacts and a KMS access pattern — added to scope as security_review_required=true.

2026-03-12: Sync with Customer Success: earliest enterprise customer onboarding that needs these artifacts: AcmeHealth and Finova. Added customer-scoped retention requirements for Finova (7 years) and AcmeHealth (3 years) to evidence catalog.
Notes: Links to artifacts and prototypes in 'links' field.
next_steps: ENG: finish normalization for multi-IdP SSO snapshots (ENG-4021) by 2026-03-20
PM: finalize canonical evidence catalog and retention matrix; circulate to legal and CS for sign-off by 2026-03-22
Security: produce KMS access pattern and approve encryption plan by 2026-03-26

notes: Phased rollout: MVP collects artifacts and surfaces missing evidence in Console; Phase 2 will support automated attestation generation.
We will keep a lightweight artifact schema to maximize interoperability with audits and external reviewers.
Fallback policy: if automated collector fails, owners receive ticket with 24h SLA; if still unresolved, escalate to oncall and freeze milestone gating until manual attestation is uploaded.
